args.summary: The v2.3.1 deploy of checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions with an error rate of 18%. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback confirmed healthy with error rate at 0.2%. No manager approval needed since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production.
args.title: checkout-api rolled back from unhealthy v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 in all production regions

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was failing health checks in all production regions with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed **v2.3.0** was the most recent release healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back** `checkout-api` to v2.3.0 across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Verified the service is now healthy with error rate down to 0.2%. No change-manager approval was needed, since v2.3.0 had been healthy in production previously.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident** `INC-0001` for checkout-api documenting the failed deploy and rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged.
